productIdentity.name: IntelliLoop
productIdentity.subtitle: The Evidence-Reconciled Active Software Twin
productIdentity.oneLinePitch: IntelliLoop builds a living, evidence-backed twin of a software change, then reconciles requirements, decisions, code and tests so teams—and their AI—can see contradictions, impact and release truth before mistakes ship.
productIdentity.primaryScenario: Expanded cancellation after picking starts but before dispatch

personas.role: Tech lead or engineering delivery lead
personas.need: Determine whether a software change is understood, supported by current evidence and ready for review or release.
Understand current requirements, contradictions, affected assets and missing validation.
See which claims and impacted paths are or are not validated.
Clarify which requirement or decision is current and what ambiguity remains.

problem.trigger: A cross-component change appears complete while its requirements, decisions, implementation state and tests have evolved independently.
problem.failureMode: Teams and generic AI assistants form a confident release view from incomplete, contradictory or stale evidence.
costAndRisk: tests that are green but incomplete for the changed rule
release decisions that cannot be reproduced

whyExistingApproachesFallShort.search: Retrieves sources without reconciling their claims.
whyExistingApproachesFallShort.projectManagement: Tracks activity and declarations rather than evidence relationships.
whyExistingApproachesFallShort.releaseChecklist: Reports completion without proving currency, scope or contradiction state.
whyExistingApproachesFallShort.genericRag: Can summarize a stale or incomplete retrieval set fluently without detecting an unselected conflicting source.
whyExistingApproachesFallShort.aiAlone: Semantic fluency is not evidence authority; scoping, invalidation and readiness require deterministic contracts.

differentiators.name: Reconciliation, not retrieval
differentiators.description: Detects disagreement, staleness and missing support instead of only returning similar content.

differentiators.name: Living change twin
differentiators.description: Keeps claims, assets, Git state, validations and findings connected and visibly invalidates dependents when evidence changes.

differentiators.name: AI with an evidence contract
differentiators.description: AI explains and proposes from a bounded cited pack while deterministic state remains independently verifiable.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Local project and repository registration
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: A real local workspace is tied safely to a controlled Git repository.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Technical credibility and a real source boundary.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Project create/retrieve, Git-root canonicalization and read-only identity/status capture.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Bounded evidence ingestion
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: Requirements, decisions, conversation extracts and validations become attributed evidence.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Shows how fragmented inputs become trusted product context.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Bounded Markdown, text and JSON import with normalization, redaction, digest, scope and persistence.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Active Software Twin
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: The change, claims, affected assets and validations appear as one traceable living model.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Bounded typed nodes/edges with provenance, revision, fact/inference and freshness.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Reconcile Core
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: Contradictions, stale claims and missing support appear with explainable reasons.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Proves IntelliLoop does more than search or summarize.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Structured claim comparison, explicit supersession, dependency invalidation and coverage-gap rules.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Change-impact traversal
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: A changed cancellation rule traces to inventory, refund, fulfilment, notification and required tests.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Connects software intelligence to concrete business consequences.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Bounded explainable traversal over typed impact, dependency, implementation and validation edges.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Evidence-cited AI explanation
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: A natural-language question receives a concise answer with facts, inferences, conflicts, gaps and citations.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Meaningful AI value with visible trust controls.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: One adapter contract, redacted evidence pack, citation validation and deterministic offline narrative fallback.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Deterministic readiness
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: The change moves honestly through BLOCKED, READY and STALE based on current evidence.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Transforms insight into a defensible decision without giving AI authority.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Small fail-closed rule set covering integrity, scope/snapshot, critical findings, required validations and review.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Thin Release Passport
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: One assessment becomes a concise reproducible evidence artifact.
DEMO_CRITICAL.judgeValue: Memorable outcome and practical business handoff.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Persisted projection containing scope, snapshot, findings, validations, status, blockers, citations and digest.

DEMO_CRITICAL.name: Competition demo workspace
DEMO_CRITICAL.userVisibleOutcome: The full apparent-green to hidden-risk to evidence-backed resolution story runs in five to seven minutes.
DEMO_CRITICAL.minimumImplementation: Controlled synthetic repository/evidence processed through real product paths plus guided views.

demo.fictionalChange: Allow customers to cancel a reserved retail order after picking has started but before dispatch.
demo.businessConsequence: An incomplete change can leave inventory reserved, fulfilment active or refund/notification behavior inconsistent even when visible tests are green.
evidenceInputs: Requirement v2 permits BEFORE_DISPATCH cancellation and requires inventory release, refund, fulfilment stop and notification.
An older ADR permits cancellation only BEFORE_PICKING and assigns inventory release differently.
A Git snapshot shows cancellation API and refund changes but no inventory-reservation consumer change.
Validation imports show order-state and refund passing but no post-picking inventory or fulfilment coverage.
A release note claims the expanded flow is ready.

steps.action: Open the apparently green change overview
steps.expected: Declared readiness is visible but not canonical READY.
Sources persist with scope, digest and attribution.
Requirement, ADR, assets, Git snapshot and tests are connected.
Requirement/ADR conflict, unsupported ready claim and missing inventory/fulfilment validation appear.

steps.action: Ask whether the change can be released
steps.expected: Answer is not yet; facts, inferences, missing evidence and citations are separate.
Order, inventory, refund, fulfilment, notification and validation paths are explained.

steps.action: Add superseding decision and missing passing validations
steps.expected: Old findings become historical/stale and successors resolve.
Deterministic state changes from BLOCKED to READY.
Passport reproduces current assessment and citations.
Assessment and Passport visibly become STALE.

demo.fallbackWithoutAi: A deterministic narrative renderer explains the same structured findings and is labeled DETERMINISTIC_EXPLANATION; reconciliation, impact, readiness and Passport remain complete.
demo.dataPolicy: Controlled synthetic data and repository only; no company, client or private source.

genuineValue: extracting candidate structured claims from prose
translating graph findings into clear explanations
answering varied natural-language questions over a bounded pack
aiBoundaries.inputContract: Explicit Project/Mission-scoped, minimized, redacted evidence pack with digest and stable citation IDs.
aiBoundaries.outputContract: Attributed advisory artifact with provider/model/request metadata when safely available and labels for FACT, INFERENCE, MISSING and CONFLICT.
aiBoundaries.citationPolicy: Every material factual statement must cite an existing pack ID; unknown citations fail validation.
aiBoundaries.providerStrategy: One provider-neutral interface and at most one optional v0.1 adapter.
aiBoundaries.aiOff: All canonical findings, impact paths, readiness transitions and Passport behavior work without an API key.
aiBoundaries.claim: The design reduces unsupported output through scoped evidence and validation; it does not eliminate hallucinations.
